@graph.description: Reproduced results for SPARQ, a skew-aware processing-in-memory accelerator for relational join and select queries (PACT 2026). This artifact contains everything needed to re-measure the paper's three measured components from a clean machine, together with every number obtained doing exactly that. 02-sparq/ reproduces the SPARQ join latencies of Figure 7 and is self-contained: the probe traces and simulator configuration ship with it, so it needs no dataset, no GPU and no network. 01-duckdb/ reproduces the DuckDB CPU baselines of Figures 7 to 11, and 03-gpu/ the RAPIDS GPU baseline of Figure 10; both need the Star Schema Benchmark dataset, generated locally with ssb-dbgen. Each directory carries a step-by-step README covering prerequisites, build, load, measurement and the metric definitions, and records the conditions that change a result by more than the effect being measured: the storage class of the database (2 to 22 times on a cold query), NUMA thread placement, query form, and the DuckDB version. RESULTS.md collects every measured value against the value the paper plots. Requirements are quantified per experiment; the measurements were taken on 2x Intel Xeon Gold 6330 with 251 GiB and an NVIDIA A100 40 GB.
